## 【投喂单元 1/8】
subject_definitions:
Subject 1: a pale-skinned young woman with flat, oil-slicked black hair sticking to her face, no makeup, wearing a loose off-white cotton T-shirt, sitting at a dark wooden desk in a dim study room. Subject 2: the dark wooden desk with scattered manuscript papers and a brush pen, a closed laptop at the edge, dominated by a cool blue screen glow. Subject 3: the small round mirror on the desk.
summary:
keyframe completion: A night-time study room; the young woman sits at the desk, the cool blue screen light illuminating her face. She sighs and touches her greasy hair, then forces a faint smile and presses the save key. Her eyelids grow heavy; she rubs her brow with her thumb joint; her eyes are bloodshot. She opens another file full of layers, huddles close to the bright screen, blinks hard, then throws her brush pen aside in frustration, covers her eyes with both hands, and hunches forward.
retention_analysis:
Subject 1: fully_preserved. Subject 2: fully_preserved. Subject 3: partially_preserved.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] In a dim study room at night, a pale-skinned young woman with flat, oil-slicked black hair sticking to her face, wearing a loose off-white cotton T-shirt, sits at a dark wooden desk. A laptop on the desk casts a cool blue glow across her tired face. She looks into a small round mirror on the desk, sighs, and lifts her right hand to touch a few strands of her greasy hair with a helpless expression. She turns back to the laptop, presses the save key with her right index finger, and the corner of her mouth lifts in a faint, forced smile. Instantly her eyelids grow heavy; she blinks slowly and heavily twice. She presses the knuckle of her right thumb hard against her brow bone and rubs it in small circles. Her eyes are red-rimmed and bloodshot, the light catching the glossy surface of her strained corneas. She opens another file; the laptop screen now shows an interface crowded with dozens of overlapping layers, each thumbnail a small piece of design work. She shrinks into her chair, leaning in so close that her face is only a hand span from the glowing screen. Her eyes are wide and unfocused; she blinks rapidly, forcing each blink. In a sudden burst of irritation, she picks up a slim black brush pen from the desk and throws it, so that it clatters across the wooden surface, then she presses both palms over her eyes and hunches her back deeply, her elbows propped on the desk while the cool blue screen glow continues to pulse steadily in the dark room. <d>[Chinese] 三天没洗，贴得跟浆糊似的。</d> <d>[Chinese] 但习惯，不代表没事。</d>
overall_soundscape:
A low hum of the laptop fan, the subtle electrical whine of the screen, the soft rustle of the young woman's clothing as she shifts, a light thud and brief clatter as the brush pen hits the wooden desk, then a faint sigh and the quiet sound of her breath as she covers her eyes.
non_diegetic_music:
A gentle yet slightly oppressive piano piece, played at a low volume, with a slow, repeating melody that settles into a quiet unease.

## 【投喂单元 2/8】
subject_definitions:
Subject 1: a pale-skinned young woman with flat, oil-slicked black hair, no makeup, wearing a loose off-white cotton T-shirt, sitting at a dark wooden desk. Subject 2: the dark wooden desk in a dim study room, a laptop screen casting a cool blue glow, a desk lamp with a small warm halo on the wall.
summary:
keyframe completion: A close-up of the young woman's side profile, the cool blue screen light on her face. Her eyes are red and dry; she blinks a few times, a single tear hanging on her eyelashes. She takes a deep breath and tilts her head up slightly, forcing herself to stay alert.
retention_analysis:
Subject 1: fully_preserved. Subject 2: fully_preserved.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Close-up, fixed camera, side view at eye-level. The young woman's side profile fills the frame, the cool blue glow from the laptop screen illuminating her face. Her eye is red-rimmed and bloodshot; she blinks dryly a few times, a single tear of moisture glistening on her lower eyelashes. She takes a deep breath, her chest rising, then lifts her chin slightly, her eyes straining to stay open, holding a forced, tired alertness. The background shows the dim study room with a soft warm lamp glow on the wall.
overall_soundscape:
A faint electrical hum from the laptop screen, a soft, deep breath as she inhales.
non_diegetic_music:
The same soft, slightly oppressive piano piece continues, sparse notes, low volume.

## 【投喂单元 3/8】
subject_definitions:
Subject 1: a pale-skinned young woman with flat, oil-slicked black hair, no makeup, wearing a loose off-white cotton T-shirt, sitting at a dark wooden desk. Subject 2: a calm man in ordinary home clothes, standing in a doorway, holding a small eye drop bottle with a blue cap and transparent body. Subject 3: the small eye drop bottle with a blue cap, transparent body containing clear liquid. Subject 4: the dark wooden desk, a closed laptop, a desk lamp casting a warm halo on the wall, in a dim study room.
summary:
keyframe completion: The young woman's hand stops on the keyboard and slowly moves away, revealing her tired eyes. At the door, a man stands quietly, holding an eye drop bottle. He steps forward, approaches the desk, and reaches his hand from beside her to firmly yet gently close the laptop. The blue screen light goes out abruptly, and the room falls into dimness.
retention_analysis:
Subject 1: fully_preserved. Subject 2: newly_introduced. Subject 3: fully_preserved. Subject 4: fully_preserved.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Medium shot, side camera position, starting on the hand action then tilting up to the man's face. The young woman's hand stops on the keyboard, fingers pausing, then slowly lifts and moves away, revealing her tired, bloodshot eyes. At the doorway of the study, a man in ordinary home clothes stands silently, his hand holding a small eye drop bottle with a blue cap. He steps forward, walks to the desk, and reaches his hand from beside her, pressing the laptop screen down firmly yet gently until it closes. The screen's cold blue light goes out abruptly, and the room falls into dimness, only the desk lamp's warm glow remaining on the wall. <d>[Chinese] 别改了。</d>
overall_soundscape:
The sound of fingers pausing on the keyboard, soft footsteps approaching, a soft click as the laptop closes, then a sudden, deep silence.
non_diegetic_music:
The piano melody fades out gradually, leaving a moment of quiet.

## 【投喂单元 6/8】
subject_definitions:
Subject 1: a pale-skinned young woman with flat, oil-slicked black hair, no makeup, wearing a loose off-white cotton T-shirt, sitting at a dark wooden desk, tilting her head back with her eyes closed. Subject 2: a small eye drop bottle with a blue cap, transparent body, held above her eye. Subject 3: the desk lamp casting a warm glow in the background, in a dim study room.
summary:
keyframe completion: A close-up, low angle shot. The young woman tilts her head back and closes her eyes. A single transparent drop falls from the bottle tip, flashing in the warm lamp glow, and lands steadily into her eye. She closes her eye, lets out a long breath, her brow gradually relaxing, as she gently rolls her eyeball.
retention_analysis:
Subject 1: fully_preserved. Subject 2: fully_preserved. Subject 3: fully_preserved.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Close-up, low angle looking up, capturing the falling drop. The young woman tilts her head back slightly, her eyes closed. The eye drop bottle, held by a hand, hovers above her eye. A single clear, transparent drop falls from the bottle tip, catching the warm desk lamp light for a brief flash, and lands steadily into her open eye. She closes her eye fully, lets out a long, slow breath, her brow slowly relaxing, and she gently rolls her eyeball behind her closed eyelid. The warm lamp glow illuminates her face, the background dim and soft, the bottle at the edge of the frame.
overall_soundscape:
A crisp, distinct sound of a single water drop, followed by a soft, long exhale.
non_diegetic_music:
Warm, soft piano music builds gently, reaching a comfortable, soothing level.

Subject 1: fully_preserved. Subject 2: fully_preserved. Subject 3: fully_preserved.

## 【投喂单元 8/8】
subject_definitions:
Subject 1: a pale-skinned young woman with flat, oil-slicked black hair, no makeup, wearing a loose off-white cotton T-shirt, leaning back in a chair with her eyes closed. Subject 2: a dark wooden desk with a closed laptop. Subject 3: a desk lamp casting a warm halo on the wall, a window showing a dark, ink-like night outside, in a dim study room.
summary:
keyframe completion: The desk lamp's warm light casts a soft halo on the wall. The young woman leans back in her chair, tilts her head up with her eyes closed, a relaxed smile at the corner of her mouth, breathing calm and even. Outside the window, the night is dark as ink, and everything is quiet.
retention_analysis:
Subject 1: fully_preserved. Subject 2: fully_preserved. Subject 3: fully_preserved.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Full shot, side-back camera position, quiet, still frame. The desk lamp's warm light casts a soft, gentle halo on the wall. The young woman leans back in her chair, head tilted up, eyes closed, a relaxed and peaceful smile at the corner of her mouth, her breathing slow and even. In front of her, the closed laptop sits on the dark wooden desk. Behind her, the window shows the deep, ink-black night. The whole scene is peaceful and still, composed with ample negative space and clean lines in the style of a Chinese ink-wash painting.
overall_soundscape:
Deep quiet, a faint ambient stillness, her steady, gentle breathing, and no sharp sounds.
non_diegetic_music:
The warm piano melody continues softly, reaching a gentle, peaceful end, then fades to silence.
